worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.summary: Release all stored chlorophyll at once as a fan-shaped blast in front: every enemy caught takes a hit that weakens with distance, and the user loses health in proportion to the power released.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.descriptio: The fan deals about %1$s Grass special damage over a %2$s-block radius and a %3$s-degree spread, catching every enemy inside with clear line of sight.
The fan's edge loses %1$s of its centre power; casting costs %2$s times maximum health, hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.burst.on: Burst: spread ×1.35 covering nearly a half-circle to catch a looser group, at the cost of a shorter radius and lower power.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.burst.off: Stream: spread ×0.7, radius ×1.2 and power ×1.08 - it reaches farther and hits harder, but covers less and is easier to sidestep.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the blast power steps up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.growth.1: From level %1$s the blast power reaches %2$s and the self-cost rises to %3$s times maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.use.0: Spray all your chlorophyll into a fan in front
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.use.1: Catch a cluster of enemies dead ahead in one blast
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.use.2: Trade a self-cost that grows with power for area pressure
worldcombat.skill.chloroblast.preference: On: spread ×1.35 covering nearly a half-circle to catch a looser group, at the cost of radius ×0.85 and power ×0.92 per target. Off (stream): spread ×0.7, radius ×1.2 and power ×1.08 - farther and harder, but narrower and easier to sidestep.
Above this distance the companion closes in before blasting. Higher fires sooner and wastes the health cost more often.
How many enemies the fan must be able to catch before firing. Higher saves the blast for clusters; at 1 it fires at a single target too.
Below this health fraction the companion stops firing (unless the target is nearly down). The cost grows with the power released, so a lower threshold spends health freely.
